data.long_description:
Experience modern waterfront-inspired living in this elegant 1-bedroom apartment at Nautis Residences. Thoughtfully designed to maximize space and comfort, this residence offers 776.61 sq. ft. of well-planned living space, featuring a bright open-plan layout, two contemporary bathrooms, and premium-quality finishes throughout.

The spacious living and dining area seamlessly connects to a modern kitchen, creating the perfect setting for both relaxation and entertaining. Large floor-to-ceiling windows allow abundant natural light to fill the interiors, enhancing the sense of space and providing a welcoming atmosphere. The bedroom is designed as a private retreat with built-in wardrobes and a stylish en-suite bathroom, while the additional guest bathroom adds convenience for residents and visitors alike.

Scheduled for completion in Q4 2027, Nautis Residences presents an excellent opportunity for both investors and end-users seeking a contemporary home in a growing community. Residents will enjoy a lifestyle focused on comfort, convenience, and leisure, with access to a range of premium amenities.
